Command `python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes,ctypes.util,struct
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
buf=bytearray(100)
def be16(o,v): buf[o:o+2]=struct.pack('>H',v)
def be32(o,v): buf[o:o+4]=struct.pack('>I',v)
be32(0,0x00050000); be32(4,0); be16(8,1); be16(10,0); be32(12,16)
be32(16,0); be16(20,42); be16(22,50); be16(24,10); be16(26,0); be16(28,0); buf[30]=1; buf[31]=0; buf[32]=0; buf[33]=0; buf[34]=0xff
# rest zeros through 55, lbGID already zeros
be32(58,66); be32(62,100); # oPasses
# pseudos zeros 66-73
be16(74,0); be16(76,0); be32(78,8)
# pass first 4 u8 at 82-85 zeros; 86-89 holes numRules+fsmOffset
prefix=bytes(buf[:86])
s=bytes([0xf0,86-15])+prefix+b'\x00\x00'+bytes([0xA0])+bytes(buf[90:100])
out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*100,100); r=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(s),out,len(s),100,100)
print('ret',r,'clen',len(s),'holes',out.raw[82:92].hex(), 'prefix matches', out.raw[:86]==prefix)
PY` executed with exit code 0.
